maria_cs: Heads-up — HelioSynth QBR prep: their monthly embedding-heavy pipeline spiked ~3x last week. Need spend forecast + token econ summary by EOD Friday. I uploaded the baseline workbook: https://redwood.internal/sheets/heliosynth-qbr

devon_finops: On it. Can you confirm which workspace keys they use? Is it per-team or shared?

maria_cs: Shared workspace (team-main). Current usage split: embeddings ~72%, chat ~20%, rerank ~8%. Note embeddings bill is non-linear — they use dense search with 1536-d vectors and high recall.

sam_onboard: I can capture recent onboarding changes — they enabled full indexing on 3/4 which likely caused the spike.

raj_csm: @devon_finops can you run a 3-month forward projection with two scenarios: 1) baseline + 1.5x growth, 2) embed optimization (batching + 8-bit quant) yielding ~40% embed cost reduction. Need numbers for the QBR slide.

devon_finops: ack. Quick clarifying Q: for scenario 2 are we assuming they deploy `embedding-cache` (our prefix cache) and convert to q4_32-ish quant profile for embeddings? Also what's the expected latency tolerance?

maria_cs: Yes — assume prefix cache enabled and switch to q4_32-like quant for infrequent lookups. Latency tolerance up to +30ms is acceptable.

ops-bot: ALERT: Account HelioSynth usage crossed 80% of monthly credits. Automated note: billing@heliosynth.com cc'd.

devon_finops: Running a sim now. If cache reduces repeated prefix calls by 35% and q4_32 reduces per-token cost by ~25%, combined embed unit cost reduction ≈46%. I'll post a quick calc below.

devon_finops: ```calc
Baseline monthly embed spend: $26,400
Scenario A (1.5x growth): $39,600
Scenario B (cache + q4_32): $21,456 (approx)
Projected runway with current credits: 22 days -> 33 days with Scenario B
```

maria_cs: Perfect. For the QBR slide deck I need: 1-line recommendation, delta table, and proposed enablement plan (30-min pre-call + 1-hour enablement runbook). Can @sam_onboard own the enablement call?

sam_onboard: Happy to run it. I'll prep a 30-min pre-call for infra and a 1-hr enablement session for their SREs. Tentative slots Wed/Thu next week. I'll add calendar invites after we lock numbers.

raj_csm: I'll draft a renewal-risk blurb — if spend stays on this trajectory we surface reserved capacity + commit tiers. Also add customer sentiment: they flagged "surprise spikes" as a top concern.

maria_cs: Good. Capture action items in the sheet and flag blockers. Also ask the customer to opt into our "auto-throttle" for burst windows (requires consent).

devon_finops: I'll add the financial appendix and recommend a commit level that keeps per-embed token under $0.002 in our model.

maria_cs: Thanks everyone. Last ask: can we get finalized numbers + slide bullets by Thursday 5pm? I'll assemble the QBR Friday morning.

sam_onboard: Will do. Adding notes & tasks to the sheet now.

raj_csm: :thumbsup:
